changes: Mistral now has its own desktop app, Vibe Desktop, for Windows and macOS. What's new opens once after this update with a farewell and a Get Vibe Desktop button.
This is the last VibeZ V4 for Windows and macOS. On those systems VibeZ stops checking for updates; the Microsoft Store copy keeps its Store updates.
VibeZ for Linux stays supported, with fixes, until the official Vibe Desktop for Linux is available.
download_highlights: Beta 5 says goodbye: Mistral now has its own desktop app, Vibe Desktop. It is the last VibeZ V4 for Windows and macOS; VibeZ for Linux stays supported until the official Linux app is available.
